test_numpy_structured_dtypes: test pybind11 numpy structured dtype creation and format descriptor generation for complex dtypes
test_recarray_creation: test creating and manipulating NumPy record arrays with simple, packed, and nested struct dtypes
test_array_constructors: test pybind11 numpy array constructors that reshape int32 data into 1D and 2D arrays

test_vectorize_functions: test vectorized pybind11 functions that operate on NumPy structured arrays and return transformed values
